name: feat-1188-step2-rework
title: #1188 steps 2–3 rework — eliminate the free vector, decide on the figure (3-D, ADR-3D-390 Am. 1)

cases.title: REFUSAL — «AB = p» then «AD = p» on a cube is a contradiction, naming both lines
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused: «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את «AD = p» יחד עם «AB = p»». Never «זו מגבלה של הכלי». The first three lines stay.
cases.before: Refused as the tool's limit: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לפתור את «AD = p» עם הווקטור החופשי p … זו מגבלה של הכלי.» (T32)

cases.title: REFUSAL — the same with a multiple: «AB = 2p» then «AD = 2p»
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused as a contradiction naming «AD = 2p» and «AB = 2p».
cases.before: Refused as the tool's limit («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: A free vector makes a quadrilateral base a parallelogram: «AB = p», «DC = p»
cases.lookFor: All four lines accepted. The base ABCD becomes a parallelogram (AB and DC equal and parallel), with the note that the base was narrowed to a parallelogram; it stays a parallelogram on «הציגו תצורה אחרת». The data panel lists «DC = p».
cases.before: «DC = p» was refused as the tool's limit («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: Already true on a cube: «AB = p», «DC = p» is accepted and p does not move
cases.lookFor: All four lines accepted; the cube unchanged; the data panel lists «p = AB» and «DC = p».
cases.before: «DC = p» was refused as the tool's limit.

cases.title: Ruling 1A: «AB = p + q» on two free vectors still builds
cases.lookFor: All four lines accepted; p and q float, and their head-to-tail chain closes on AB.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a ratio letter on a free vector is still the tool's limit
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused with the tool's-limit sentence quoting «AE = t·p».
